title: Probe Label Availability Matrix
evidence_cutoff: Frozen evidence snapshot: 26 October 2026; inventory prepared 27 October 2026. No live remote queue or new calculation checked.
independence_definition: Independent means the reference label was not generated by the evaluated frozen DPA. A source-fitted effective potential is marked separately from direct DFT force constants. Published reuse, EOS derivation and new DFT remain distinct.

status_definitions.scoped: Available for the stated scope; not a certificate of full convergence or structure–label pairing.
status_definitions.candidate: Artifact exists; reference/protocol or pairing acceptance is incomplete.
status_definitions.unverified: No matched accepted label was verified in the inspected evidence; not a claim that none exists remotely.
status_definitions.blocked: The stated physical route fails its applicability gate.
status_definitions.missing: No admitted result for this layer/task; other reference tiers may exist.

cost_definition: Costs describe how information is acquired. Existing compute is not zero-cost in method comparisons. New target DFT/phonons are extra input budget; no fabricated wall times, GPU-hours or SU estimates.
